lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, quasi-circular pixel clusters are arranged in semi-linear vertical columns along the mid-posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature extends across the upper-mid flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient in luminance with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-intensity circular nodes distributed across its lateral surface.
